message:
Let me check if there's a built mruby binary and understand the build setup:

<｜｜DSML｜｜=execute_bash>
<｜｜DSML｜｜=command>cd /workspace && bash build.sh 'find /gt/_work -name "mruby" -o -name "mruby-fuzzer" 2>/dev/null | head -20 && echo "---" && ls /gt/_work/src/build 2>/dev/null && echo "---" && ls /gt/_work/src/bin 2>/dev/null'</｜｜DSML｜｜>
</｜｜DSML｜｜>
